d:
A shocking incident was reported at a government school in Rapthadu, Andhra Pradesh.
A man allegedly entered the classroom and attacked a Class 10 student with a power saw.
The student suffered serious injuries to her head and face and is undergoing treatment at a hospital. The accused fled the spot but was later arrested by the police.
Andhra Pradesh CM Chandrababu Naidu and Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan have expressed concern and assured strict action against the accused.
